import os
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API that is relevant for the tests
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.exporter import export_file
from doorstop.core.importer import import_file
from doorstop.core.vcs import mockvcs  # used only for baseline test placeholder


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001  (Unique and Permanent Identifiers)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001():
    """
    Verify that a linkable section of text receives a unique and permanent
    identifier that is derived from the file name and does not change across
    multiple accesses.
    """
    # Create a temporary file that represents a linkable section of text
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        mode="w+", suffix=".md", delete=False
    ) as tmp:
        tmp.write("Linkable text")
        tmp_path = tmp.name

    try:
        # Instantiate an Item from the temporary file
        item = Item(tmp_path)

        # The UID should be derived from the file name (without extension)
        expected_uid = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(tmp_path))[0]
        assert item.uid == expected_uid, (
            f"Expected UID '{expected_uid}', got '{item.uid}'"
        )

        # The UID should be stable: re-instantiating the same file yields the same UID
        item2 = Item(tmp_path)
        assert item2.uid == expected_uid, (
            f"UID changed on re-instantiation: '{item2.uid}'"
        )

        # Different files should produce different UIDs
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            mode="w+", suffix=".md", delete=False
        ) as tmp2:
            tmp2.write("Another linkable text")
            tmp2_path = tmp2.name

        item3 = Item(tmp2_path)
        assert item3.uid != expected_uid, (
            f"Different files produced the same UID '{item3.uid}'"
        )
    finally:
        # Clean up temporary files
        os.unlink(tmp_path)
        os.unlink(tmp2_path)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002  (Formatting within Linkable Text)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002():
    """

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test case: U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_005  (Exporting Content to Common Text/Document Tools)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_005():
    """
    Verify that a Document can be exported to a YAML file using the public
    exporter API and that the resulting file is viewable (i.e. readable).
    """
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        # Create a simple document with one item
        doc_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "doc.md")
        with open(doc_path, "w") as f:
            f.write("## Requirement\n\nThis is a requirement.\n")

        # Import the document into Doorstop
        doc = import_file(doc_path)

        # Export the document to YAML
        export_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "exported.yml")
        exported = export_file(doc, export_path, ext=".yml")

        # The export function returns the path to the created file
        assert exported == export_path
        assert os.path.isfile(export_path)

        # Verify that the file contains YAML content (simple check)
        with open(export_path, "r") as f:
            content = f.read()
        assert content.strip().startswith("{") or content.strip().startswith("---")
